# UMES

> UMES provides website design and development, digital marketing, content and analytics, and network architecture from Kashmir for clients worldwide.

The official website is https://umes.in/. UMES works with clients to define project scope, design and deliver services, and provide ongoing support and improvement.

For project inquiries, email contact@umes.in or call +1 (313) 646-8164.

## Overview

- [Homepage](https://umes.in/): Overview of UMES, its services, delivery process, and contact information.

## Services

- [Website Design & Development](https://umes.in/services/web-development.html): Website development, domain and hosting setup, maintenance, and technical support.
- [Digital Marketing](https://umes.in/services/digital-marketing.html): Search engine optimization, Google and Meta ads, social media, analytics, and conversion optimization.
- [Content & Analytics](https://umes.in/services/content-analytics.html): Blog writing, editorial content, Google Analytics (GA4) setup, and measurement to guide improvements.
- [Network Architecture](https://umes.in/services/network-architecture.html): Network topology and backbone design, zero-trust security, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, and network audits and optimization.
